info.headline: Notify NYC - Unplanned Road Closure - Henry Hudson Parkway (MN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-06-2026 at 01:49 AM.
Due to a vehicle fire, all northbound lanes of the Henry Hudson Parkway are closed at West 158 street in Manhattan. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnTjHH.
